w35f.headline: AI Detected
windows: So you can tell what each change does, add the new things in this phase one at a time, starting with the UMP trial and working down the list below to the keto diet.
5-HTP could help your mood here, though iboga acts on serotonin too, so don't take 5-HTP at all while you're microdosing iboga or elliptica.
But if you want UMP with any microdose, or 5-HTP with a mushroom microdose, there isn't enough data yet to say whether the warnings against taking them on psychedelic days apply.

Until there is, you can try the supplement each way, on days you microdose and on days you don't, and see how each feels. If the numbness makes that hard to tell, your sleep and dreams on those nights are easier to compare.
Like iboga, mushrooms act on serotonin, so stop the 5-HTP if you get any of the stop signs the 5-HTP section lists.
